rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Hill Giant
"You cannot stay on our lands, little one... I say, you must leave!"

Ranger
"Follow the river North. There, you will find the city Thrugre'sh... Our spies tell us that this is where Slookarijj has been imprisoned!"

Ranger
"We have been ambushed! The treacherous Undead Hordes were waiting for us... We must use our sorcery to vanquish these beasts!"

Ranger
"We have discovered holy ground! A hero who fought during the First Great Wars is buried here. His brave spirit will aid us..."

Tiorek
"I told you not to approach... Bring back my brother Horek, or next time I will not be so generous!"

Necromancer
"Aaaaaaaarrrggggghhhhh! We lost this battle, but the war is not over yet! Mortis knows many ways to annihilate your kind!"

Ranger
"We are near, Milord! Slookarijj is East of here. We must hurry!"

Barbarian
"You will never make it through the mountains alive! You are weak!"

Barbarian
"A treacherous attack! How dare you invade our city? You will not live to regret this..."

Ranger
"We defeated the Orc King Akgraak! We must be careful hereafter... The Greenskins will most certainly seek revenge for the death of their sovereign."

Goblin
"You mistake! Invade lands and kill.  King Akgraak wait for you and death for you!"

Goblin
"What you want? Too late for you, Akgraak now cush you!"

Cleric
"We must ally with the Mountain Clans so we can retrieve Uther.  He is the savior all talk of, the Highfather has blessed us!"

Alchima
"Thank you for freeing me! The Loremaster thought he could gain immortality by drinking my blood... I will gladly join you in your quest!"

Insane Loremaster
"No nooooo! How did you find me?! Do not think that I don't know what you seek... I will never liberate her! Never! The Archangel's blood will grant me divine strength. Ha ah ah ha!"

Horek
"Thank you for saving me! My brother Tiorek will be generous if you escort me to him... Our home is to the Northwest."

Horek 
"Please help me reach my brother..."

Horek 
"Brother! I am back! The Empire has saved me... Please, reward them for saving me from the thugs."

Tiorek
"Yes! For saving the life of my brother, I give you the Quicksilver Potion, a familiy specialty. It will be sent to your capital. Thanks again, friends..."

Apprentice
"Have you heard what the peasants have been saying? They talk of a savior who will cleanse the lands and free the Empire... I wonder if this will ever be!"

Ranger
"The Emperor's son Uther has been found! A dwarf messenger has come... He says that Uther was found deep in their mountainous territory. How could a mere boy survive ten years in the mountains? He is surely the savior foreseen by the mages!"
Take a look at my wares, I may have something of interest for you.
My wares can help you in your quest.

Agraak
"I Akgraak, King of Orc. Me know what you do to Greenskin. Now I kill all of you!"
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.

Pegasus Knight
"Slookarijj, the Mountains Clans diplomat, has been freed! Negotiations with the Mountain Clans can start now, Milord.  
We regret to say that Uther is still missing, despite our best efforts..."
Everything I possess is for sale.

Ranger
"Our scouts have informed us that the Mountain Clans diplomat is somewhere upon these lands. He was captured while coming to meet our party! The fate of the Empire is in our hands now... The diplomat Slookarijj must be freed!"

Ranger 
"Our enemies have many allies, they will surely try to hinder our efforts..."
Tiorek"Approach no more or you will feel my might! You are not welcome here. However, if you bring me my brother Horek, I will reward you... He has been kidnapped by a band of thugs!"

Ranger
"The dwarf is mad, Milord! He claims to have captured an Archangel... What should we do?"

Insane Loremaster 
"Leave me alone, fools! I have no need for your petty concerns - I shall live forevermore..."

Archer
"Be stealthy, Milord! This area is infested with Greenskins, they become aggressive if you pass near them..."
